Why did Edison say he never failed 10,000 times?

Kevin explains how Thomas Edison answered when he was asked how it felt to fail 10,000 times on the light bulb. Edison said he hadn't failed. He had found 10,000 ways that would not work, and each one brought him closer.

Kevin calls that a mindset. He says it separates people who feel happy and successful from people who spend their days complaining.

When did you last treat a setback as a step forward?

#ad #mindset #success #kevintrudeau

What you resist will persist. Why do we keep fighting it?

Kevin explains that most people deny what is happening, or complain about it, and that only gives it more power. He says you have to acknowledge it, not deny it and not resist it.

When something painful hits, you can't pretend you feel fine. Accept it, let the feeling move through you, and allow yourself a good cry.

What are you resisting in your life right now?

#ad #mindset #happiness #kevintrudeau

Ten good reviews, one bad one. Which one sticks with you?

Kevin says we accept anything negative more readily than anything positive. He describes studies showing that people read one bad review of a restaurant next to ten good ones, and then skip the place.

He calls that being manipulated by other people's opinions, and says it holds many people back from the life they want.

Whose opinion has talked you out of something you wanted?

#ad #mindset #success #kevintrudeau

How can a setback turn into a fresh start?

Kevin says that when people asked how he dealt with the adversity of prison, his answer was that it wasn't adversity. In his words, the universe cleared his plate.

He describes using that time to write a course of more than 100 lessons, to read more than ever, and to come out with a blank canvas to do exactly what he wanted.

When did a setback turn out to be your fresh start?

#ad #mindset #freedom #kevintrudeau
